title: AzurealDamaGE
description: This plugin displays a player's damage and health information in the boss bar when you hit them on PvP servers. It only has one version and is compatible with Paper version 1.21, but you should download and try it anyway.
body:
powered by nxyzhan
discord support: nxyzhan 
This plugin allows players on PvP servers to display their damage taken, maximum health, and name on the boss bar. If the player's health is between 20-15, it will show green; between 15-5, it will show yellow; and between 5-0, it will show red.
